in_tamil.name: சிதானந்த

in_telugu.name: చిదానన్ద
in_telugu.meaning: చిత్ (చిత్తము, consciousness) ఆద్యమ్ (ఆద్యము, self) అనన్ద (ఆనన్దము, joy, bliss)

in_marathi.name: Chidananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chidananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chidananda is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chid' meaning consciousness or self and 'Ananda' meaning bliss. This name signifies the attainment of supreme bliss through the realization of the true self.
